description: This figure group contains a single image and it is not a scientific figure: it is a formal head-and-shoulders portrait photograph, i.e. an author biography photo inserted into the review article rather than a data figure. The subject faces the camera against a plain white background, framed from the top of the head to the upper chest. She has short dark hair, a neutral closed-mouth expression, and wears a light blue short-sleeved top printed with a large pink-and-red floral (chrysanthemum-like) motif on the shoulders. The photograph is in colour and is legible at the supplied resolution; there are no panel letters, axes, units, scale bars, legends, arrows, or annotations of any kind. Consequently no micrograph, spectrum, curve, map, table, schematic, or specimen is shown, and the image contributes no materials-science evidence. The accompanying caption states that Hu Shufen is an associate professor and master supervisor at the Department of Mechanical Design and Manufacturing, Jiangxi Agricultural University, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province, China, with research directions in material science and processing engineering; the pixels themselves confirm only an adult female portrait and cannot corroborate any of those assertions.
